oracle.invariant: S1: 202 {code: BACKUP_PENDING} both times, one host job filed, no site.backup audit row. S2: a new backup is made (200, version 4) and the old row reads done; a failed job is still 502 FLEET_JOB_FAILED. S3: pending, unconfirmed, unconfirmed, unconfirmed, failed, failed, rate-limited. S4: [data-backup-outcome=pending] "Still making the backup"; [data-backup-outcome=unconfirmed] "Result not confirmed yet"; neither says "Nothing on the site was changed", the host failure does; Restore everything failed reads "The restore did not go through"; [data-backups-failed] above the list on 502, nothing on 404.
